gloss_en: Mashiach — the Messiah, the anointed redeemer of Israel whose advent brings the final redemption; in Likutey Moharan identified as the aspect of the nose/breath ('ruach apeinu meshiach H'', who 'smells and judges'), of prayer, and embodied in Moshe and the tzaddik of the generation (not a generic anointed priest/king, and not the verb מָשַׁח 'to anoint')
